description: Luw.ai Photo Enhance AI: enhance the quality of an image and enlarge it 2x, 3x or 4x (8x is sent as 4x). Costs 1 credit.

image.description: Image to upscale (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

precision.description: How strictly to keep the input's structure: 90 = precise, 75 = balanced, 40 = creative.

scale.description: 2, 3 or 4 (default 2). 8 is accepted and gives 4x, the largest size.

name: luw_upscale_image
title: Upscale an image
